environmentVariables.name: WAZUH_API_USER
environmentVariables.description: Manager API user. Exchanged for a short-lived JWT and never printed.

environmentVariables.name: WAZUH_INDEXER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Wazuh indexer URL used for events, findings and vulnerability state.

environmentVariables.name: WAZUH_INDEXER_USER
environmentVariables.description: Indexer user for search tools. Required only for search_events, search_findings and search_vulnerabilities.

environmentVariables.name: WAZUH_INDEXER_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Indexer password. Required only for the indexer search tools.

environmentVariables.name: WAZUH_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: When true, restart_agents is not registered.

environmentVariables.name: WAZUH_VERIFY_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Verify TLS certificates for the manager API and the indexer.

environmentVariables.name: WAZUH_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for one request.

environmentVariables.name: WAZUH_MAX_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Truncate tool output longer than this many characters.

environmentVariables.name: WAZUH_EVENTS_INDEX
environmentVariables.description: Indexer data stream for raw events.

environmentVariables.name: WAZUH_FINDINGS_INDEX
environmentVariables.description: Indexer data stream for rule-match findings.
